name: limit_profile_straddling_the_axis
why: A PROFILE THAT CROSSES THE AXIS MUST BE REFUSED, and this case measures WHAT really refuses it. The operation has two nets: SOLIDWORKS not creating the feature, and the count of the bodies right after. With this profile -- a rectangle from y=-20 to y=+20 around the axis y=0 -- the FIRST one fires: FeatureRevolve2 returns null and the refusal is «must lie on the profile plane, and the profile must not cross it». The expected message is that one, not that of the count: a red that fires for the wrong reason proves nothing and gives the same green line on the outside.
_safety_net_not_seen: I HAVE NEVER SEEN THE BODY COUNT FIRE. It is in SwOperations.cs right after the feature («created the feature but the document has N solid bodies instead of one») and no case brings it there: the profiles I tried either make a single solid or make no feature. A check never seen to fire is not a check -- it stays written here so that it is known that that line is still a promise and not a measurement.

message_includes: must lie on the plane of the profile
the profile must not cross it
